item.title: CVE-2026-121652 - Stored cross-site scripting (XSS) in AWS Amplify maplibre-gl-js-amplify popup rendering
item.description:
Bulletin ID: 2026-167-AWS
Publication Date: 11/03/2026 10:30 AM PST

Description:

maplibre-gl-js-amplify is an open-source AWS Amplify library that integrates Amazon Location Service with MapLibre GL JS to render maps, markers, popups, and geofencing controls in web applications. We identified CVE-2026-121652, where a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) issue in the library's popup and geofence-control rendering.

Impacted versions: <= 4.0.2

Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin.

Read this article

item.title: CVE-2026-124034, CVE-2026-124035: Issues with Amazon Braket SDK
item.description:
Bulletin ID: 2026-175-AWS
Publication Date: 11/09/2026 14:15 PM PST

Description:

Amazon Braket SDK is an open source Python library that customers use to run quantum tasks and hybrid jobs on Amazon Braket.

We identified CVE-2026-124034, an issue in the local hybrid job input data download in the Amazon Braket SDK. And we identified CVE-2026-124035, an issue in the error mitigation schema validation in Amazon Braket Schemas, the library the Amazon Braket SDK uses to parse quantum task results.

Impacted versions:
- amazon-braket-sdk >= 1.10.0 AND < 1.127.7
- amazon-braket-schemas >= 1.17.0 AND < 1.32.2

Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information.
